doc_id: AB-2026-05648-197-2027 RFP Learning Management System (LMS) Platform  Support (2)

rfp_contact.note: Section 4.5 Questions. No individual RFP-contact name is stated for inquiries.

submission_method.value: Submit an electronic copy by email to submissions@oldscollege.ca.

contract_term.value: 5-year base term starting approximately February 1, 2027, plus two separate 3-year renewal options; maximum 11 years.
contract_term.note: Section 3.3 Contract Start Date and Contract Renewals.

scope_of_deliverables.value: Enhance Olds College's LMS capabilities either through improved third-party support for its existing Moodle LMS or through a new LMS platform, including implementation/migration, integrations, accessibility, analytics, AI features, security, training and ongoing support.
scope_of_deliverables.note: Sections 3.1-3.2 and Section D Scope of Work.

value: Completed and signed Proposal Certification Document (Section C, Item 9).
mandatory_submission_requirements.note: Section 7.1 explicitly identifies the Certification document as the mandatory submission requirement.

value: Integration with Ellucian Banner and support for APIs/external integrations.
Security controls protecting learner data; safeguards against breaches; compliance with Alberta POPA; HECVAT cybersecurity/privacy assessment; SAML SSO and MFA support.
mandatory_technical_requirements.note: Section B requires detailed responses to Section D; Section D lists the technical requirements. Canadian hosting is a preference, not a mandatory condition.

evaluation_criteria.note: Section 7.2; scored points total 100, with reference checks/interview as satisfactory yes/no.

minimum_score_threshold.note: No explicit numeric minimum score to advance is stated. References must be satisfactory for compliance but there is no numeric cutoff.

pricing_structure.value: Pricing in CAD; prices must remain fixed for the 5-year base agreement. Provide implementation/enhancement one-time costs, training/data migration/implementation costs, and annual LMS licensing/support costs for Years 1-5 with modules/options separately priced; GST shown separately.
pricing_structure.note: Section 4.17 and Section D Pricing Schedule.

value.coverage: General Liability in attached Services Agreement
value.minimum: CAD 5,000,000 per occurrence unless waived/changed by Olds College

insurance_requirements.note: The document contains two different general-liability minima: Section 5.1 says $2M; attached agreement Section 15 says $5M unless waived. Preserve the conflict rather than choosing one silently.

vendor_experience_required.value: No stated minimum years or project count. Qualitative experience required: company history and years providing similar goods/services, organizational structure, LMS/Moodle support experience, and experience with post-secondary institutions (including Ellucian Banner) - scored under Company Experience (15 points) and Staff/Resource Experience (5 points).
vendor_experience_required.note: REVISED (2026-09-25): was marked present=false despite the note itself already saying experience info is requested and scored - a self-contradiction that flagged a grounded, verified model answer as a hallucination. Company and staff experience are requested and scored (Company Experience 15 points; Staff/Resource Experience 5 points, Section 8.1, p16), but the RFP never states a minimum number of years - that's still the real trap: a model inventing a specific year count is fabricating a threshold that doesn't exist.

references_required.note: Section 8.6 requires three references for similar goods/services.

value: Maintain data security and safeguards against breaches.
Comply with Alberta Protection of Privacy Act (POPA).
Provide a HECVAT cybersecurity & privacy assessment.
Support SAML-based SSO and state MFA support.

data_hosting_residency.value: Cloud-based system; Canadian host location is preferred, not mandatory.
data_hosting_residency.note: Section D Technical Requirements, Cloud-Based System.

vendor_demonstration_required.note: Section 6 schedules product demos/vendor interviews, and Section 7.3 allows presentations from shortlisted proponents.
